text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Prod SLO breach detected for streaming-proxy (p95/p99) — p95 crossed 600ms, p99 crossed 2.5s. Auto-threshold hit. Dashboard: <https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/1902123456|incident-1902123456>

maria-sre: seeing the alert. streaming requests show tail stalls and a lot of KV cache misses on prefix-cache. Investigating dashboards now.

jtaylor: looking at cache metrics — prefix-cache hit rate dropped from ~92% to ~6% starting at 12:04 UTC. Request rates steady. No downstream deploys except one small prefix-hash update at 12:05.

pavan: that prefix-hash change was pushed in the release 2026-03-14T12:03:50Z to improve sharding. Could be correlated.

iris-pm: any 5xxs or customer errors? product getting p95 complaints from a few dev customers. No broad 5xx spike on API gateway.

maria-sre: correct — 5xxs are not rising, but streaming tails are stalling (clients see chunks delayed for several hundred ms). That aligns with KV misses causing synchronous fetches from backing store.

jtaylor: quick checks — log excerpts: ```
[2026-03-14T12:06:02Z] stream-request id=abc123 backend=prefix-cache miss -> fetch(kv-store) latency=350ms
[2026-03-14T12:06:03Z] stream-request id=abc124 backend=prefix-cache miss -> fetch latency=410ms
```

maria-sre: runbook: paging -> prefix-cache-regression. Steps: identify deploy, consider rollback or enable fallback routing. I'm going to try a targeted rollback of the prefix-hash change in staging and if consistent, roll back prod.

pavan: rolling back prefix-hash change requires touching configmap shard-seed and restarting prefix-service to pick up old hash. That will invalidate some warmed state but should restore hit rates.

infra-bot: Started rollback job `rollback-prefixhash-20260314` against deployment/prefix-service in prod. Job id: rb-190212-01. (ETA 3m)

maria-sre: running quick script to sample redis hit rate: ```
# measure hits in last 5m
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood.ai/api/v1/query?query=prefix_cache_hit_rate%5B5m%5D" | jq .
```

jtaylor: after the rollback started (12:10 UTC) I'm already seeing hit-rate climb: 6% -> 78% in 4 minutes. p95 dropped from 600ms -> 150ms. p99 trending down to ~300ms.

pavan: confirming the rollback removed the new hash seed and restarted prefix-service pods. No deploys to other services. Will keep monitoring.

iris-pm: customer impact summary for ops: which customers were affected and for how long? We should open support tickets for the top impacted accounts.

maria-sre: preliminary estimate: ~23 customers experienced degraded latency on streaming endpoints between 12:04–12:16 UTC (~12 minutes until rollback fully warmed). Most requests were slower but no functional failures. We'll generate a more precise query across customer IDs.

jtaylor: collecting top prefixes requested (hot prefixes) and running a prewarm job to reduce cold misses: ```
python tools/prefix_warm.py --top 1000 --target cluster=prod
```

infra-bot: Prewarm job started (job pw-190212-01). Warmup progress: 0% -> 60% -> 100% (12:21 UTC).

maria-sre: post-mitigation metrics: p95=140ms, p99=280ms, streaming stall count back to baseline. Cache hit-rate stable ~90%. No new deploys.

incident-bot: Incident update: Mitigation applied (rollback prefix-hash), warmup run, metrics recovering. Please escalate if client reports persist. Link to timeline: <https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/1902123456/timeline|timeline>.

iris-pm: assigning next steps: (1) postmortem owner? pavan will own triage and root-cause writeup. (2) action item: add pre-deploy canary for prefix-hash changes to detect hit-rate regressions — infra to add gating. (3) update runbook with fallback routing step.

pavan: will own postmortem. Initial RCA hypothesis: change in prefix-hash algorithm altered distribution and caused effective mass invalidation because new hash namespace didn't match warm keys — produced immediate miss storm. We should add a compatibility step in deploy pipeline.

sre-oncall: taking handoff for follow-up and customer comms. I'll work with support to contact top 5 affected accounts, attach latency graphs and timeline. Handing off on-call to @sre-oncall for next 8 hours.

maria-sre: noted. Leaving monitoring alerts tightened temporarily (lower thresholds) and adding synthetic checks for top 50 prefixes.

jtaylor: saved logs and query results to the incident folder: <https://console.redwood.ai/storage/incidents/1902123456/logs|logs>. Also added scripts used for rollback & warmup.

iris-pm: thanks everyone. Postmortem prep checklist assigned to pavan. We'll aim for a draft within 48h. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status changed to "mitigated" by maria-sre at 12:23 UTC.

maria-sre: handing off to sre-oncall for customer follow-ups and monitoring. If any regressions, page immediately.

sre-oncall: acknowledged. I'll keep an eye on the synthetic checks and coordinate support outreach.

infra-bot: Reminder: create a canary job to validate prefix-cache hit-rate post-hash-change. Ticket created: <https://issues.redwood.ai/INC-190212|INC-190212>.
